- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Triggers on: "chart", "graph", "plot", "data viz", "visualization", "dashboard", "analytics", "visualize data", "categorical colors", "sequential / diverging palette", "stat tile", "sparkline", "heatmap", "legend", "axis", "tooltip", "chart colors", "color by series".
- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.

content.text:
h14.

**Computation site**

The derived metadata is the memo's `Payload.Property` (plus `Payload.Tags`). It's assembled in `RebuildMemoPayload` at `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74`, which delegates the actual content parsing to the goldmark-based markdown service `ExtractAll` at `internal/markdown/markdown.go:356` (single-pass AST walk). The equivalent property-only logic also lives in `ExtractProperties` at `internal/markdown/markdown.go:193`.

```go
// runner.go:80-86
data, err := markdownService.ExtractAll([]byte(memo.Content))
...
memo.Payload.Tags = data.Tags
memo.Payload.Property = data.Property
```

**Triggers (recomputation)**

- **Create memo** — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108` calls `RebuildMemoPayload` on every new memo.
- **Update memo, only when `content` is in the update mask** — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:446-451` sets the new content and rebuilds the payload (other field updates like visibility/pinned do not recompute).
- **Batch/backfill rebuild** — `Runner.RunOnce` at `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27-72` iterates all memos in batches of 100, calling `RebuildMemoPayload` + `UpdateMemo` for each (e.g. migration/startup rebuild).

**Extracted properties**

From the AST walk in `ExtractAll` / `ExtractProperties` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:383-405`):

- `Title` — text of the first block-level child if it's an H1 heading.
- `HasLink` — true if any link node exists.
- `HasCode` — true for any code block, fenced code block, or inline code span.
- `HasTaskList` — true if any task checkbox exists.
- `HasIncompleteTasks` — true if any task checkbox is unchecked.
- `Tags` — collected from `#tag` nodes (and `Mentions` from `@user` nodes are gathered in the same pass, though only Tags/Property are written back to the payload).

## Summary

In this repository (usememos/memos), derived memo metadata is computed on the **Go backend** in two places: **persisted metadata** (tags + boolean properties + title) is stored in the memo's `Payload` and recomputed on create/update, while the **snippet/summary** is computed on the fly at read/convert time (not persisted).

## 1. Where the metadata is computed

### Core extraction engine — `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go`

The `markdown.Service` (goldmark-based) does all content parsing. The single-pass extractor used in production is `ExtractAll` (lines 355–422). It walks the goldmark AST and populates an `ExtractedData` struct:

```go
type ExtractedData struct {   // lines 20-25
    Tags     []string
    Mentions []string
    Property *storepb.MemoPayload_Property
}
```

Key extraction logic (lines 376–408):
- Tags: `asMemoTagNode(n)` → `data.Tags`
- Mentions: `*mast.MentionNode` → `data.Mentions` (lowercased)
- Title: first block-level child that is an H1 heading → `data.Property.Title` (lines 383–389)
- `KindLink` → `Property.HasLink = true`
- `KindCodeBlock/KindFencedCodeBlock/KindCodeSpan` → `Property.HasCode = true`
- `east.KindTaskCheckBox` → `Property.HasTaskList = true`; if `!checkBox.IsChecked` → `Property.HasIncompleteTasks = true`

There is also a standalone `ExtractProperties` (lines 193–241) with identical property logic, and `ExtractTags`, but production code uses `ExtractAll` for efficiency (single parse).

Snippet generation: `GenerateSnippet(content, maxLength)` (lines 263–346) walks the AST, skips code blocks, concatenates text/autolinks/tags, and truncates at a word boundary.

### Payload assembly / persistence trigger — `/bench/repo/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go`

`RebuildMemoPayload` (lines 74–88) is the exact site that assigns derived metadata onto the stored memo:

```go
func RebuildMemoPayload(_ context.Context, memo *store.Memo, markdownService markdown.Service) error {
    if memo.Payload == nil {
        memo.Payload = &storepb.MemoPayload{}
    }
    data, err := markdownService.ExtractAll([]byte(memo.Content))
    if err != nil {
        return errors.Wrap(err, "failed to extract markdown metadata")
    }
    memo.Payload.Tags = data.Tags
    memo.Payload.Property = data.Property
    return nil
}
```

Note: only `Tags` and `Property` are persisted to the payload here (mentions are extracted but handled elsewhere, e.g. `memo_mention_helpers.go`).

### Snippet computation at read time — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go` and `memo_service_webhooks.go`

The snippet is NOT persisted; it is computed each time a memo is converted to the API response:
- `memo_service_converter.go:76-80` calls `s.getMemoContentSnippet(memo.Content)` and sets `memoMessage.Snippet`.
- Batch path: `memo_service_converter.go:221-252` (guarded by `includeSnippets`).
- Helper `getMemoContentSnippet` — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:83-90` — calls `GenerateSnippet([]byte(content), 64)` (max length 64).
- `convertMemoPropertyFromStore` (`memo_service_converter.go:315-326`) maps the stored `Property` (HasLink, HasTaskList, HasCode, HasIncompleteTasks, Title) into the API response.

## 2. Operations that trigger recomputation

Persisted payload (`Tags` + `Property`) is rebuilt via `RebuildMemoPayload` at:
- **On create**: `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108` (in `CreateMemo`).
- **On update/patch**: `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:447` — only when the `content` field is in the `UpdateMask` (`path == "content"`, lines 436–451). It then sets `update.Payload = memo.Payload`.
- **Bulk backfill / migration**: `/bench/repo/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27-72` (`Runner.RunOnce`) rebuilds the payload for all memos in batches of 100 and calls `Store.UpdateMemo`.

Snippet is (re)computed on every read/convert of a memo into the API response, plus in relation listings (`memo_relation_service.go:154,162`) and notifications (`user_service_notifications.go:323`).

## 3. Properties extracted from content

Stored on `MemoPayload` (proto: `/bench/repo/proto/gen/store/memo.pb.go`):
- `Tags []string` — field 3 (line 28)
- `Property *MemoPayload_Property` — field 1 (line 26)

Stored on `MemoPayload_Property` (proto lines 85–95):
- `HasLink bool` (field 1) — content contains a link
- `HasTaskList bool` (field 2) — content contains a task checkbox
- `HasCode bool` (field 3) — content contains fenced/inline/block code
- `HasIncompleteTasks bool` (field 4) — content has an unchecked task checkbox
- `Title string` (field 5) — text of a leading H1 heading, if present

Computed at read time (not stored):
- `Snippet` — plain-text summary, max 64 chars, code blocks skipped, truncated at word boundary.

Note: there is **no** derived `thumbnail` or `first image` field in this codebase's memo property model — the extracted derived fields are exactly the five Property fields, plus Tags (persisted) and Snippet (on-the-fly). Mentions are also extracted by `ExtractAll` but not stored on the payload.

The frontend consumes these as generated proto types in `/bench/repo/web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service_pb.ts` (`Memo_Property`, `Memo.snippet`, `Memo.tags`); the frontend does not compute this derived metadata itself.</result>
